# Kredoxi governance repository memory

## Project purpose and scope

Kredoxi replaces credentials in configuration with non-secret references resolved
at authenticated, authorised runtime boundaries. This `.github` repository owns
the organisation profile and community/governance defaults. Architecture belongs
in `kredoxi/architecture`; implementation belongs in `kredoxi/kredoxi`.

Kredoxi is a conventional software agent, not an AI agent. No reference resolves
merely because an agent is running. An authorised compromised application can
expose received credentials. Privileged-host protection, memory confidentiality,
transparent interception, and production readiness must not be assumed.

## Governance authority

Canonical `.github/carl/` artifacts and effective instruction packs govern coding
assistants. Harness files are adapters, not independent authorities. The installed
cARL v1.0.2 runtime is upstream tooling, not the product implemented here.
Bundled assets are kept canonical; project guidance is an additive selected pack.
Installed packs are not necessarily effective. No active profile file is used;
explicit selection in `packs.json` supplies compatibility-mode active seeds.

Hydrate the current contract, invariants, trust boundaries, tool policy, this
memory, selection/runtime state, and effective packs before implementation.
Validate exact contract assertions, then reconcile durable truth.

## Operating boundaries

Never merge automatically, create production releases, add an unapproved licence,
access real credential stores, or use privileged tests on a non-disposable host.
Use synthetic test credentials only. Licence selection remains an owner decision.
Do not configure mandatory approvals that deadlock a sole-maintainer repository.
Require demonstrated checks and protect branches from force pushes and deletion.

Community defaults take effect from the default branch and can be overridden by
repository-local files. They do not automatically apply workflows, cARL selection,
Dependabot configuration, or branch protection to other repositories.

## Validation and maintenance

Install CI-only dependencies with `python -m pip install -r requirements-ci.txt`.
Run `python scripts/validate_governance.py`, `carl status`,
`carl pack effective --json`, `carl trace`, and `carl harness status`.
CI uses the pinned cARL release with a committed SHA-256 check.
Diagnostics demonstrate local artifact health and pack composition, not model
compliance or a product security guarantee.

Run `carl map` and `carl reconcile` after structural changes. On Windows, explicitly
use the intended installed CLI if PATH resolves another version.

GitHub settings must be read back before reporting enablement. Organisation
Actions administration requires permissions beyond repository administration;
record unavailable scopes and manual actions in `docs/GOVERNANCE.md`.
